data.body: **[P2] Preserve registration-order startup context.** `createPlugins(info)` constructs every plugin before any plugin receives `onInvocationStart`. Both OTel factories now extract context, read `Span.current()`, and create the invocation span in their constructors, so an earlier registered plugin can no longer install propagation context before OTel fixes the parent and sampling decision. This can produce incorrectly parented or sampled traces. Interleave each factory creation with that plugin's start hook, or defer OTel context/span initialization to `onInvocationStart`; add a two-plugin ordering regression test.
